programs.title: THE HAWK
programs.meta: Intermediate · 3 days · high rep, kettlebell, upper body

programs.title: DARK FIST
programs.blurb: A fighting-game-inspired striking session: spinning kicks, jumping knees and demon-rush chains in the air, then on the bag, then a slam circuit.
